name: omp-console
description: Android app and VPS control plane for running Oh My Pi agents remotely.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @omp-console/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @omp-console/backend
scripts.test: npm run build:protocol && npm run test -w @omp-console/backend
scripts.dev: npm run build:protocol && npm run dev -w @omp-console/backend
